skill-workflow-composer v1.0.1

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No changes to functionality, features, or documentation compared to version 1.0.0.

Initial release of Skill Workflow Composer.

- Scans both local and marketplace skills, categorizes, and displays them on first use—does not invent or cache data, marks sampling clearly.
- Allows users to compose multi-skill workflows at three levels: in-session (L1), scheduled automation (L2), and reusable process (L3).
- Proactively generates 3–5 multi-skill combination inspirations, each with required six elements and value assumptions.
- Enforces strict “guardian” constraints: skill load budget (≤5/session), trigger conflicts, cycle detection, user confirmation before actions, and clear boundaries with connector/data-flow tools.
- Unified, highly structured workflow planning and delivery using required templates and a standardized execution interface.
- Read-only fallback mode clearly spells out capability limits if platform tools are unavailable.
